headline_marked: [[US launches third wave of attacks, hitting 140 targets in Iran]] after ship assault
headline: US launches third wave of attacks, hitting 140 targets in Iran after ship assault
summary: US Central Command confirmed hitting 140 targets in Iran in a third wave of attacks. This follows an alleged IRGC assault on a Cypriot-flagged container ship in the Strait of Hormuz.
details: The US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that 140 targets in Iran were hit in a third wave of attacks. These strikes were reportedly in response to an alleged attack by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) on the Cypriot-flagged container ship M.V. GFS Galaxy.
The container ship was reportedly crossing the Strait of Hormuz when the incident occurred. Iran International reported these developments on Sunday, July 12.

Meanwhile, on Saturday, July 11, the Associated Press, citing US officials, stated that President Donald Trump has given American negotiators a limited timeframe to reach an agreement with Iran. Officials also indicated that Trump has various options available should the negotiations fail.

Separately, Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei issued a statement on Saturday. He declared that avenging the death of his father, Ayatollah Khamenei, in the February 28 air strike is a national demand, warning that this demand must be fulfilled.
caption:
US Central Command has confirmed a third wave of attacks on Iran, striking 140 targets.

The US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that 140 targets in Iran were hit in a third wave of attacks. These strikes were reportedly in response to an alleged attack by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) on the Cypriot-flagged container ship M.V. GFS Galaxy.

The container ship was reportedly crossing the Strait of Hormuz when the incident occurred. Iran International reported these developments on Sunday, July 12.

Meanwhile, on Saturday, July 11, the Associated Press, citing US officials, stated that President Donald Trump has given American negotiators a limited timeframe to reach an agreement with Iran. Officials also indicated that Trump has various options available should the negotiations fail.

Separately, Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei issued a statement on Saturday. He declared that avenging the death of his father, Ayatollah Khamenei, in the February 28 air strike is a national demand, warning that this demand must be fulfilled.

headline: Argentina reaches semi-finals after defeating Switzerland in extra time
summary: Goals from Julian Alvarez and Lautaro Martinez secured Argentina's victory over Switzerland, propelling them into the tournament's semi-finals after a tense extra-time battle.
details: Argentina secured their spot in the semi-finals by overcoming Switzerland in a thrilling encounter that extended into extra time. The hard-fought victory sees the South American giants continue their campaign in the prestigious tournament.

The decisive goals came from Julian Alvarez and Lautaro Martinez, who found the back of the net during the crucial extra-time period. Their clinical finishes proved the difference in a tightly contested match.

Both teams displayed strong defensive efforts throughout regular time, leading to a stalemate that necessitated the additional periods. Argentina's perseverance ultimately paid off, breaking the deadlock and securing their progression.
caption:
Argentina has advanced to the semi-finals after a dramatic extra-time victory against Switzerland. Julian Alvarez and Lautaro Martinez scored the crucial goals.

Argentina secured their spot in the semi-finals by overcoming Switzerland in a thrilling encounter that extended into extra time. The hard-fought victory sees the South American giants continue their campaign in the prestigious tournament.

The decisive goals came from Julian Alvarez and Lautaro Martinez, who found the back of the net during the crucial extra-time period. Their clinical finishes proved the difference in a tightly contested match.

Both teams displayed strong defensive efforts throughout regular time, leading to a stalemate that necessitated the additional periods. Argentina's perseverance ultimately paid off, breaking the deadlock and securing their progression.
